description.en: Removes a single party member with the standard "member left" presentation (BGM fades out for 30 frames, waits 45, plays system SE 21, shows the "sysmes-remove_party" message, then the BGM fades back in) — a fixed-preset wrapper around RemoveParty_MessageEx.
Param ID of the character to remove from the party.
Whether to reset the member's status.
Optional; when true, removes the member without locking their slot (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Remove a party member with the standard departure presentation
RemoveParty_Message("para_cp0009", false);
